title: Pavé Zigzag Ring
descriptionHtml:
A zigzag, lit in the middle. A fine polished band breaks into one sharp zigzag across the top of the finger, like a lightning bolt: it rises, turns, crosses, turns and rises again. Only the middle stretch carries stones, a single line of eight tiny round clear cubic zirconia, while the steep arms on either side stay plain polished gold. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8.

STYLING TIP: Stack it beside the Asscher Solitaire Ring, one line next to one stone.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Profile: One zigzag with two sharp bends, approximately 9mm tall
  • Stone: A single line of eight tiny round clear cubic zirconia along the middle of the zigzag
  • Band: Approximately 1.5mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
